Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS interactome study using TMT labeling and DDA acquisition. While the biological focus is on ISGylation and Ubiquitination, the mass spectrometry part described in the 'Mass-spectrometry' section and PRIDE metadata is specifically for the interactome (protein-protein interactions) using GFP-nanotrap beads, not for PTM-peptide enrichment (which was done via Western Blot/biochemical assays in other parts of the paper).
